data.one_liner: Message internationalization and localization framework with OpenAI translation tools integration.
data.what_it_does: Provides a framework for message internationalization and localization with support for package-based message structures, dynamic asset loading, plurals, and CLI tools integrated with OpenAI for fixing translations.
use_when: You want to load localization messages dynamically from assets using custom .intl files.
You need built-in pluralization support with custom condition blocks.
You want to integrate CLI tools with OpenAI to check and format translations.
avoid_when: You prefer standard arb-based localization or static code generation for translations.
You need a comprehensive Flutter-specific widget library with built-in context extensions.
strengths: Built-in support for plural rules and custom variable substitution.
Includes a CLI tool for checking, formatting, and fixing localization files using OpenAI.
weaknesses: Relies on custom .intl file formats rather than standard ARB formats.
Limited ecosystem documentation compared to larger localization packages.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Dart internationalization library for standard formatting and messages.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Easy translation management for Flutter with JSON, CSV, and YAML support.
